purpose: Physically validate the Computer Use P2B provider-neutral text-region interpretation contract using the already observed local macOS Vision OCR provider as an oracle, without resolving semantic identity or executing an action.
requiredClaims: the real P1B mapped-frame path supplies a physically validated mapped PNG
the real product perception-provider contract accepts an injected provider declaring text-region capability
the provider-neutral contract validates exact capture-pixel top-left frame geometry
two test-owned strings observed by the local Vision provider are normalized by Computer Use as text-region observations
normalized observations have semanticIdentity null and actionable false
the observation centers still map through P1B into independently known logical fixture windows
no pointer, click, drag, wheel or keyboard action is performed
frame payload, recognized text and coordinates are not persisted or logged
fixture and Computer Control runtime are cleaned up
both product working trees remain clean
nonClaims: macOS Vision is not made a built-in Computer Use dependency by this test
no VLM, object detector or icon-recognition contract is validated
text-region observations are not semantic UI identities
no observation is selected as an actionable target
no low-level action derived from visual perception is executed
no arbitrary user-content OCR accuracy claim is made
event delivery is not equated with semantic task success

promotionOnPass.nextPhase: P3 observation-to-target resolution and policy boundary
